contract.direct_answer:
I cannot provide verified ENSDARG identifiers for the segment-specific markers from this evidence bundle. Based on general zebrafish pronephros knowledge, the canonical segment markers are: proximal tubule (proximal convoluted tubule = slc20a1a; proximal straight tubule = trpm7/slc13a1), distal early = slc12a1 (NKCC2), distal late = slc12a3 (NCC), and pronephric duct = gata3 / slc4a4. HOWEVER — the retrieved bundle contains NONE of these markers or their IDs. The only pronephros-relevant hit (CORPUS-2026-0003) concerns tubulogenesis and epithelial identity via the polarity proteins Prkc iota and zeta (prkci/prkcz), not segment marker delineation. No ENSDARG identifiers were resolved or verified in the DI store ('none checked'), so I am withholding all specific gene IDs rather than assert them from memory. This question cannot be answered rigorously from the provided evidence.</parameter>
